source: The programmer specifies the grid and block shape. The hardware/runtime determines where blocks run subject to architectural and resource constraints. This separation is one of ZXNAME0000XZ’s scalability ideas: a kernel can describe much more parallel work than the current device can execute at once.[1]
zh: 程序员指定网格和块的形状。硬件/运行时决定块在何处运行，但受架构和资源限制。这种分离是 ZXNAME0000XZ 的可扩展性思想之一：内核可以描述比当前设备可以同时执行的并行工作多得多的并行工作。 [1]
